engineeringSkip.reason: A false-vacuum bubble would expand at essentially the speed of light and no known physics offers any way to stabilise the Higgs field locally or contain it, so this is speculation with no real research or engineering basis.

factCheck.reason: A collapsing vacuum bubble would expand at near the speed of light and no known field or shield could slow or contain it, so 'vacuum decay containment' is not a real engineering possibility.
